messages:
alessandra: quick sync — i put a short proposal in the doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/degrade-exposure-proposal. TL;DR: we want to (1) surface a minimal, deterministic reason when requests are degraded/routed (2) provide a small set of client-visible hints for retry/fallbacks and (3) show a console badge + drilldown that links to telemetry and rollout status. asking eng-platform + runtime + devex for API + sdk implications.
ryan: nits — what form are we exposing the reason in? headers? body? both? we should be explicit about SDK mappings so console and apps get consistent UX.
maggie: prefer header-first: headers are non-breaking and parsable by gateways. propose: `X-RW-Route-Decision: degrade` and `X-RW-Degrade-Reason: capacity|quota|sli|circuit` and `X-RW-Routing-Priority: low|normal|high`. also include a short machine-readable tag for fallback model: `fallback=llama-3-qa-quant`.
sam: +1 to headers. SDKs should convert that into typed exceptions with `retryable` bool and optional `suggested_delay_ms`. sample mapping we discussed:
```
X-RW-Degrade-Reason: quota
X-RW-Retryable: true
X-RW-Suggested-Delay-MS: 1200
```
ryan: what about status codes? we can't overload 503 for everything. propose: keep 429 for quota/rate, 503 for infrastructure fallbacks, 424 for degraded result (soft degrade but response ok). need a table.
priya: flag: telemetry/privacy — don't include tenant IDs or routing path details in headers. headers should be enumerated tokens only. full routing metadata only via internal trace. also sampling: telemetry ingestion for these events at 1% by default; bump for canary.
alessandra: good call on sampling. product wants console badge that summarizes % of requests experiencing degrade by route and by reason. drilldown should show timeline and latest rollout toggles.
sam: console folks: we can expose a 3-state badge (none / minor / major) where minor = <1% of requests degrade last 1h, major = >5%. threshold numbers can be flags. need example UX copy for console tooltip.
maggie: runtime: we need a compact enum so kernel selection doesn't bloat responses. enum values: `quota`, `capacity`, `sli`, `circuit`, `version-mismatch`, `region-unavailable`. keep to these for now.
ryan: sdk impact: we should add a first-class `DegradeInfo` object in the SDKs with fields `reason`, `retryable`, `suggestedDelayMs`, `fallbackModel`. sample JS snippet:
```
try {
  const res = await client.generate(...)
} catch (e) {
  if (e.degradeInfo?.retryable) await backoff(e.degradeInfo.suggestedDelayMs)
}
```
priya: ops: for rollouts, tie degrade signals to `release_id` and `model_variant` in telemetry only (not in client headers). that lets us correlate without leaking.
alessandra: rollout plan suggestion: week 1 internal canary on prod route, sample telemetry at 10% plus verbose logging; week 2 public canary with headers on for 5% of customers; week 3 full flip with console badging. approvals from security + compliance required before public canary.
ryan: actionable: i'll draft the header contract and status-code table today and post PR. Maggie, can runtime emit the enums as specified? also add a toggle for `X-RW-Degrade-Verbose: 1` that we can opt-in for canary tenants only.
maggie: yes we can emit enums; verbose toggle OK but needs guard in config so we don't explode logs.
sam: i'll stub SDK changes and add mapping for Python/JS/Go. will include sample error messages for client-facing copy. propose: client copy for `quota` -> "Request rate exceeded for this tenant. Retry after suggested delay or switch to a cached/embeddings-only flow." keep short.
priya: monitoring checklist: create SLO alerts for degrade rate per-route, CI job that runs the header parsing in SDK smoke tests, and a runbook entry for `degrade-major` events. I'll own alert thresholds.
alessandra: outstanding questions: 1) exact HTTP codes table (ryan to PR), 2) console copy & thresholds (sam + product finalize), 3) telemetry sampling params (priya finalize). can we aim to have PRs and console mockups by EOD Friday? :thumbsup:
ryan: yep, will open PR by 1600 PST today.
maggie: will add runtime patch to feature branch, aiming for canary build Thursday.
sam: SDK stubs incoming, will add console tooltip drafts.
priya: I'll create the runbook skeleton and alert rules this afternoon.
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: canary/routing-feature-flags -> feature-branch -> staging at 2023-09-14T18:40:00Z (note: timestamped for canary planning)
alessandra: thanks all — i'll update the doc with the decisions and link the PRs. next sync if any blocker: ping #eng-platform. :raised_hands:
